title: Grandpa's Recording
summary: Judy's grandfather sent her a recorder from Oregon, and she has cut his last recording of Laguna Bend into a braindance for V.
description: Judy's grandfather sent her a recorder from Oregon, and she has cut his last recording of Laguna Bend into a braindance. She wants V to come over and see it.

start.bringUp: Your grandfather sent you a recorder from Oregon, and you cut his last recording of Laguna Bend into a braindance. Bring up, in your own way, that you want V to come over and see it.

lakeshore.name: the lakeshore road below the old Laguna Bend reservoir

hill.name: the hill above the reservoir, where her grandfather stood

J6.gift.01.text: Grandpa sent me something. I made something out of it. For you. Come over?

J6.gift.02.text: Sit down. Bring nothing, you already did.

J6.gift.03.text: He built this recorder in the fifties. Recorded Laguna Bend the week before the water.

J6.gift.04.text: Never showed anyone. Not even me, till now.

J6.gift.05.text: I cut it into a braindance. Only one copy.

J6.bd.01.text: Main street. Smell that? Hot asphalt and somebody's barbecue.

J6.bd.02.text: That's me. The kid with the hockey stick. I was a menace.

J6.bd.03.text: Flo's. The burger was bigger than my head. Still tasted better than anything since.

J6.bd.04.text: Everyone came to the church when they read the notice. Listen to how quiet it is.

J6.bd.05.text: His hands. Mine. I didn't know he was recording.

J6.bd.06.text: And this is the last frame. He went up the hill to look at it all, one more time.

J6.bd.07.text: You okay? Breathe slow. The sensory layer's heavy at the end.

J6.drive.01.text: I want to stand where he stood. Will you come?

J6.drive.02.text: My van. I drive. You hold the coffee.

J6.drive.03.text: Grandma used to sing in the car. Badly. He'd harmonise, worse.

J6.frame.01.text: Up the hill. He always went higher, so we go higher.

J6.frame.02.text: Stop. Left a bit. There. That's where he stood.

J6.frame.03.text: Don't move. I'm lining it up with his frame.

J6.frame.04.text: Same view. Fifty years. Different water.

J6.frame.05.text: Now one of us. Come here, I'm not asking twice.

J6.frame.06.text: Hey, you moved! ...Fine. My memory's better than a camera anyway.

J6.stay.01.text: Sit. The sun does a thing over the water in a minute.

J6.stay.02.text: The church is still down there. I dove it once. I've told you that.

J6.end.01.text: Our hill now. Don't bring anyone else up here.

J6.end.02.text: Next time you hold still for one photo. That's the deal.

g1.asks: Do you want to see it? You can say no. I'd understand.
g1.know: The recorder and the braindance, and what is in it: the six images.
g1.wants: Yes, with all her heart, said lightly.

s1.asks: What would you keep? If your town went under. One thing.
s1.know: The flood, and her grandparents in Oregon.

stages.label: Judy asks V to come to her flat
stages.objective: Go to Judy's flat to see her grandfather's recording
stages.know: Your grandfather sent you a recorder from Oregon, and you made something out of it for V. You want V to come over and sit down.
stages.wants: V to come to your flat.

stages.label: Judy shows V the braindance of Laguna Bend
stages.objective: Watch the Laguna Bend braindance with Judy at her flat
stages.know: You cut the braindance from your grandfather's recording of Laguna Bend, the week before the flood. Each image is one of his frames, and you talk V through them.
stages.wants: V's eye on each image, and V's answer about what V sees.

stages.label: Judy drives V out to Laguna Bend
stages.objective: Drive Judy out to the old town of Laguna Bend
stages.know: You are driving your van out to the old town. You are talking about your grandparents, not your ghosts.
stages.wants: V to ride along and see where he stood.

stages.label: Judy lines V up with her grandfather's frame
stages.objective: Stand with Judy on the hill where her grandfather stood
stages.know: You walked V up the hill above the reservoir to the spot where your grandfather stood. You are lining up the same frame fifty years later.
stages.wants: V to stand still on the spot for half a minute while you line it up.

stages.label: Judy and V sit together at the view
stages.objective: Sit with Judy on the hill above the reservoir
stages.know: The sun is setting over the water where the town was. You are sitting on the hill beside V.
stages.wants: V to stay and watch the sunset with you.

frame-end.memory: You stood where Judy's grandfather stood, fifty years after his last frame of Laguna Bend, and watched the sun go down over the water.
frame-end.history: Judy calls the hill above the old reservoir 'our hill'.

rushed.memory: You walked off the hill before the photo was taken, and Judy teased you about it.

missed.memory: You never came to Judy's flat to see the braindance, so she kept her grandfather's recording to herself.
